youtubeTitle: GTA 6 Launch Trailer Released Rockstar Games
socialHook: Rockstar Games has just released the official GTA 6 Launch Trailer, a 90-second in-game shadowdrop confirming the November 19 2026 launch.

sections.heading: Trailer Release Details
paragraphs: The Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer (Trailer 3) has been released by Rockstar Games, published to all social media channels at 2pm BST on Thursday 15th October. The 90-second video is confirmed entirely in-game from PlayStation 5 (not PS5 Pro) and reiterates the November 19 2026 release date. Rockstar confirms the trailer introduces Jason and Lucia whose easy score goes wrong, plunging them into a criminal conspiracy across Leonida.

sections.heading: Music and Additional Details
paragraphs: The trailer features new music from electronic duo Justice, whose track "Flower in a Hurricane" includes Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. This standalone single will be available on the official GTA VI soundtrack, currently available to pre-save on major streaming services and on vinyl/CD pre-order. Rockstar also confirmed that the game's ending has partially been leaked and detailed new realism systems including the in-game sweat mechanic.
